description: Spec 25: the guessing game's win condition as a `check`. `[ "$guess" = "$secret" ]` -- exit 0 is a WIN, non-zero is a miss. With guess == secret (the default here) the flow reaches `win`, which no decide flow can do (the head answers `higher` for an equal guess). Override with GUESS=<n>.

nodes.run: echo 'WIN: the guess is the secret'
